direction_classifier.name: Direction Classifier
direction_classifier.head: binary
direction_classifier.description: Predict direction at horizon (next bar close, or first hit of profit/stop/time barriers). Output: P(up). Works with any algorithm that supports `classification`.

range_classifier.name: Range-Bucket Classifier
range_classifier.head: k-class
range_classifier.description: Quantize next-N-bar high-low range into K buckets. Output: P(bucket_k). Headline metric: within-2-point accuracy.

multi_head.name: Multi-Head (Direction + Magnitude + Confidence)
multi_head.head: multi
multi_head.description: Joint output heads: direction (binary), magnitude (regression), confidence (Bernoulli). Requires an algorithm flagged `supports: multi-head`.

online_direction_skill.name: Online Direction (skill vs majority)
online_direction_skill.head: regression
online_direction_skill.description: Forecast the H-bar forward log return from a streaming learner, scored PREQUENTIALLY (every bar is scored before it is trained on, so the metric is out-of-sample by construction). Headline is SKILL = hit rate minus the RUNNING MAJORITY CLASS -- never raw accuracy, because MNQ's up-rate is 0.4811 at H=1 and 0.5566 at H=1440, so the majority flips sides with the horizon and a fixed 0.50 baseline flatters the model.
